state:
**Goal `tooling-overhaul`, Stage 10.** The cutover is on `main`. `main` stays frozen, and tag `pre-overhaul` is the rollback. The Stage 9 check `no goal file carries a number` passes when run by hand. The failure in the ledger was recorded before the cutover commit.

`bun nv playbook --triage <section>` is on disk (`tools/nv/cmd/playbook.ts:707`). It prints each bullet's text, the files it names, what a bare name among them resolves to, a proposed `gone` trailer, `LIVE MANIFEST`, `NO NAMED WORD IN ITS FILE`, its near-duplicates, and the closing `triage:` line. Section `divergences` is decided: 11 bullets deleted and 17 kept with a `gone` trailer. The other sections still owe: `splitting-a-file` 13 of 13, `running-things`, `writing-novis`, `tooling` 301 of 397, and `writing-a-test-case`.

A bullet still has two homes that are read: the fragment under `docs/agent/playbook/<section>/` (which `nv orient` and `--show` read through the importer) and the record under `data/playbook/<section>/`. A batch changes both. `.agent-tmp/triage-divergences.ts` is the batch script to copy: it checks each proposed `gone` condition stands, rewrites the fragment's trailer, writes the record as `bulletValue` reads it back, and deletes both homes of a dropped bullet.

The goal-only sweep is red on the four checks later stages own: Stage 9's `audit checks`, Stage 11's `audit ci` and `loop-stats --guard`, and Stage 12's `audit python`, plus Stage 10's trailer check until every section is triaged. The scratch worktree `.agent-tmp/worktrees/cutover-rehearsal` and its branch can be removed.
